system.description: In addition to its Possess talent, each haunted mask has one of the below talents based on the emotion it depicts. Anger: The wearer attacks the nearest creature on each of its turns. The wearer gains 10 temporary HP and deals +[[/r 1d4]] damage. Fear: The wearer becomes jumpy and flees at the slightest sign of danger. The wearer’s shrill, uncontrollable screams attract a great deal of attention. Sorrow: Unbearable sadness overcomes the wearer and they turn their weapon upon themselves. Mirth: The wearer falls to the ground in a fit of hideous, gasping laughter. In addition to the noise, the wearer begins suffocating as if drowning.
